planItems.scope: New nested catalog thinking/context metadata has no independently reviewed same-version CLI wire/rail evidence. Preserve chat priority/deny, discovery-only app entries, known effort mappings and context field locations; do not infer rights from the newer desktop-facing reference.

Qoder portion. Normalized source request and final prepared model_config produce bounded requested/effective diagnostics on four ingresses, both modes and three rails, including same-account recovery and failed preparation.

localCorrections.disable: Source Claude disabled and Gemini zero budget become the existing none directive before generic bridges; models without an audited disable capability reject before generation.
localCorrections.preciseBudgets: Reject exact token budgets instead of changing them into effort; Gemini -1 remains unspecified/dynamic and is an existing passing regression.
localCorrections.validation: Reject invalid/unknown/conflicting efforts before catalog or generation; accept only bounded reviewed aliases and do not echo unknown input.
localCorrections.upstream: No new vendor field, identity, transport, entitlement, retry branch, rail fallback, state writer or Router/Web schema.

diagnostics.source: Existing normalized directive; effective comes only from final prepared model_config is_reasoning/reasoning_effort.
diagnostics.semantics: Preparation is not dispatch or vendor execution. An enabled toggle without a known level stays unknown. Unknown catalog strings do not become labels. Each retry clears the previous effective result.
diagnostics.mapping: The audited gm51model high-to-max mapping remains; qmodel toggle-only does not invent a concrete effort; omitted controls may expose a known declared catalog default.

redEvidence.result: Native disabled was sent enabled; exact budget generated; failed preparation and successful auth recovery omitted requested diagnostics.
redEvidence.excluded: red1 fixture type errors and red2 fixed-model auto admission mismatch are not product failure evidence.

validation.rustInputDigestMethod: sha256 of sorted canonical path/sha256 array with sort_keys and compact separators
